summary.text: Eric Su is the Republican candidate for the Illinois House of Representatives, District 21, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Democrat Abdelnasser Rashid.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a small business owner, community fitness professional and father.

paragraphs.text: Eric Su earned a high school diploma from Glenbard East High School and a bachelor's degree from Purdue University in 1999, according to Ballotpedia.
Su said in a Ballotpedia survey that he has worked for more than 20 years as a coach and entrepreneur serving families, seniors and working professionals.
He advanced from the March 17, 2026 Republican primary for District 21.
His survey lists affordability, public safety and accountability, and local leadership as his key messages, and names United Hellenic Voters of America as an endorser.
